ai.title: The new economics of enterprise AI
ai.brief: As enterprise AI shifts from isolated experiments to becoming foundational infrastructure, companies need to focus on efficiency, not just consumption. Imagine your company just discovered electricity. At first only a few machines run on it, and nobody worries about efficiency — consumption is low and the value is obvious. " Enterprise AI is going through the same shift. What began as isolated chatbot and copilot experiments is becoming a foundational layer of the business, with models, agents, and data increasingly interconnected in production workloads. The important question stops being what a token or GPU-hour costs. It becomes how efficiently the AI environment converts paid capacity into useful business outcomes. That's the metric worth tracking: effective cost per useful outcome — the total platform, model, operations, and capacity cost required to complete work the business can actually use, whether a resolved request or a completed workflow.

sec.title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
sec.brief: S. and Europe have been breached by the SafePay ransomware gang since August 2024, according to a new advisory from international law enforcement agencies. K. said SafePay is now “among the most active ransomware groups in 2026” and is targeting businesses and critical infrastructure by guessing passwords, exploiting vulnerabilities and using phishing attacks. The advisory was created based on numerous FBI and German law enforcement investigations involving SafePay, with the most recent incident occurring in August. The advisory lists multiple vulnerabilities the group has used in attacks, including CVE-2020-3259, CVE-2023-20269, CVE-2023-27532 , CVE-2024-40711 , CVE-2024-40766 and others. “Once inside the network, SafePay actors establish control by creating new accounts or taking over existing ones,” the agencies said . ”
